title: Kronos Engine: Zenodo Evidence Package for JAMIA 2026 Manuscript
description: Frozen experiment artifacts and manuscript evidence package for 'Kronos Engine: A Deterministic Counterfactual Experimentation Platform with Sentinel Adapter Pattern for Multi-Scale Health System Simulation' (JAMIA 2026 submission). Contains frozen JSON results for P-003 (WWII counterfactual), P-004 (Deers Rock sentinel), and Phase F (causal-null replication), along with the primary manuscript, claim audit, experiment freeze documentation, and reproducibility guide.
notes: This is the evidence package for a JAMIA 2026 manuscript. The companion software repository (github.com/rikirinjani/Kronos-Engine) is not yet public. DOI is pending Zenodo publication. All frozen artifacts are verifiable against commit 4d7e4128f6ad800fa762f443f36aa4f45d31e4d9.
